description: AI news digest Sep 24: Android BYOA, offline Antigravity, Perplexity RTX PC, FLUX Action, Q.ANT SDK, agent hijacks, sem-ai.
lead: Agents move into your IDE and onto your own GPU, open weights reach robots and photonic chips, and two security warnings land before your next agent run. Google opened Android Studio to any coding agent and took the Antigravity SDK offline with local models, Perplexity brought its local agent to Windows RTX PCs, Black Forest Labs published an open action model for robots, Q.ANT shipped a photonic SDK you can try on a laptop, researchers showed how poisoned history can hijack coding harnesses, and Semaphore put CI/CD behind an agent-first CLI. Every summary is in our own words; follow the links for the original reporting.
title: AI news digest — September 24, 2026: IDE agents, local AI PCs, open robotics
